paragraphs: Primis Financial Corp. is the bank holding company for Primis Bank, a Virginia state-chartered bank which commenced operations on April 14, 2005. Primis Bank provides a range of financial services to individuals and small and medium-sized businesses.

As of December 31, 2025, Primis had $4.0 billion in total assets, $3.3 billion in total loans held for investment, $3.4 billion in total deposits and $423 million in total stockholders' equity. As of December 31, 2025, Primis Bank had 24 full-service branches in Virginia and Maryland and also provides services to customers through certain online and mobile applications. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, the Company has an administrative office in Glen Allen, Virginia and an operations center in Atlee, Virginia. PMC, a residential mortgage lender headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina, is a consolidated subsidiary of Primis Bank. PFH owns the rights to the Panacea Financial brand and its intellectual property and partners with the Bank to offer a suite of financial products and services for doctors, their practices, and ultimately the broader healthcare industry. PFH was deconsolidated from the Company on March 31, 2025, as further

discussed below in "PFH Deconsolidation and Sale of Shares". The operating results of PFH were included in the Company's consolidated operating results through March 31, 2025. Primis Bank's deposits are insured, up to applicable limits, by the FDIC.

We make our annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K and amendments to those reports filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act available free of charge on our website at www.primisbank.com as soon as reasonably practicable after we electronically file such material with the SEC. These reports are also available without charge on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov. We include our website address throughout this filing only as textual references. The information contained on our website is not incorporated in this document by reference.

Primis is focused on building a new, innovative, and better banking experience for its consumers and small and medium-sized businesses. The Bank intends to grow its business, expand its customer base and improve profitability by focusing on the following three areas:
1. Maintaining a strong and efficient community bank in desirable markets.
a. The Bank maintains twenty-four office locations in attractive markets in Virginia, Maryland and the Greater Washington, D.C. market
b. In these markets, we increased deposits per branch (excluding digital platform deposits) to $100 million as of December 31, 2025 versus $69 million as of December 31, 2021
2. Supplementing core community bank growth and profitability with business lines that we believe can generate above-average risk-adjusted returns such as:

a. The Panacea Financial Division, the Bank's health-care focused brand which ended 2025 with $544 million of loans and $128 million of deposits. This was up from December 31, 2024 when loans were $434 million and deposits were $92 million.
b. Primis Mortgage Company, the Bank's retail mortgage company which had funded production of approximately $1.2 billion in 2025, up from approximately $800 million in 2024; and

c. Mortgage Warehouse Lending, which focuses on lending to the independent mortgage company space and which ended 2025 with approximately $1.2 billion in approved lines, $318 million in outstanding loan balances and $29 million of low or no interest customer deposits.
3. Perfecting enhanced digital offerings that allow Primis to attract and retain deposit customers at scale both in and out of our footprint.

a. Deposits on the Bank's digital platform ended 2025 at $992 million with an average balance of $48 thousand. As of December 31, 2025, 82% of those customers had been with the Bank's digital platform for more than 2 years.

An investment in our common stock involves risks. The following is a description of the material risks and uncertainties that Primis Financial Corp. believes affect its business and should be considered before making an investment in our common stock. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently deem immaterial, also may become important factors that affect us and our business. If any of the risks described in this Annual Report on Form 10-K were to actually occur, our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be materially and adversely affected. If this were to happen, the value of our common stock could decline significantly and you could lose part or all of your investment. This Form 10-K also contains forward-looking statements that may not be realized as a result of certain factors, including, but not limited to, the risks described herein and in our other public filings with the SEC. Please refer to the section in this Form 10-K entitled "Special Cautionary Notice Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" for additional information regarding forward-looking statements.

Our business is subject to a number of risks, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and prospects. These risks are discussed more fully after the summary, and risks include, but are not limited to, the following:
● We are subject to risks related to our concentration of commercial real estate and construction and land development loans.
● We have a meaningful amount of consumer loans that are unsecured and if the borrower defaults on the loan, we have no collateral to recover potential losses.

● A portion of our consumer loan portfolio is originated and serviced by a third-party and includes a credit enhancement, which may not be realizable; the inability to utilize such credit enhancement could be detrimental to our financial condition and results of operations.

● A significant amount of our third-party serviced consumer loans were originated during a zero-interest promotional period, exposing us to third-party credit risk for interest foregone in the event of borrower prepayment; the failure of such third-party to perform under its reimbursement obligation could be detrimental to our financial condition and results of operations.

paragraphs: We organized the core bank and lines of business in a way that we believe will drive premium operating results. Our strategy centers on growing earning assets back to previous levels after the sale of our Life Premium Finance division in January 2025, growing non-interest deposits, and achieving higher production and profitability in our retail mortgage business. We continued to execute successfully during 2025 on our strategies, which included the following key highlights:

● The core Bank's loan portfolio was essentially flat at $2.1 billion at December 31, 2025, compared to $2.2 billion at December 31, 2024. The core Bank has low concentrations of investor commercial real estate loans as a percentage of the overall loan portfolio.

● The core Bank's cost of deposits was 1.74% for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to 2.15% for the year ended December 31, 2024. Approximately 23% of the core Bank's deposit base at December 31, 2025, are noninterest bearing deposits.
● The core Bank had zero brokered deposits and low utilization of FHLB borrowings at December 31, 2025.

● Outstanding loan balances grew 25% to $544 million during the year ended December 31, 2025 from $434 million as of December 31, 2024. The year-over-year growth was despite a $54 million loan sale in December 2025.
● Outstanding deposits were $128 million as of December 31, 2025, up 38% from December 31, 2024.
● Outstanding loan balances as of December 31, 2025 were $318 million, up 398% from $64 million as of December 31, 2024.
● Mortgage warehouse funded approximately 14% of the outstanding loans with associated customer noninterest bearing deposit balances, which totaled $29 million as of December 31, 2025.
● Committed facilities were up 252% to $1.2 billion as of December 31, 2025, compared to $349 million as of December 31, 2024.
● Funded loan volume was $1.2 billion during the year ended December 31, 2025, up 50% from the year ended December 31, 2024.
Primis Financial Corp. 為 Primis Bank 的銀行控股公司，Primis Bank 為一間於維吉尼亞州立案的銀行，於 2005 年 4 月 14 日開始營運。Primis Bank 向個人及中小企業提供多樣化的金融服務。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Primis 總資產為 4.0 十億美元，總放款為 3.3 十億美元，總存款為 3.4 十億美元，總股東權益為 423 百萬美元。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Primis Bank 在維吉尼亞州與馬裏蘭州共有 24 家全功能分行，並透過某些線上與行動應用程式為客戶提供服務。本公司總部設於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩，並設有行政辦公室於維吉尼亞州格倫艾倫，以及運營中心於維吉尼亞州阿特利。PMC 為一間住宅房貸貸款機構，總部設於北卡羅來納州威明頓，為 Primis Bank 的合併子公司。PFH 擁有 Panacea Financial 品牌及其智慧財產權，並與銀行合作提供一套金融產品與服務，服務對象為醫生、其診所，以及最終更廣泛的醫療產業。PFH 於 2025 年 3 月 31 日從本公司脫離合併，如後述 "PFH 脫離合併與股份出售" 所述。PFH 的營運結果已包含於本公司合併營運結果中，直至 2025 年 3 月 31 日。Primis Bank 的存款由 FDIC 保險，保險金額以適用的限額為限。
如後文「PFH 脫離合併及股份出售」所述。PFH 的營運成果已包含於本公司合併營運成果中，至 2025 年 3 月 31 日為止。Primis Bank 的存款由 FDIC 依適用之限額提供保險。
我們會在電子檔向 SEC 提交後儘快於我們的網站 www.primisbank.com 免費提供年度報告（Form 10-K）、季報（Form 10-Q）、現況報告（Form 8-K）以及這些報告的更正檔。這些報告亦可於 SEC 網站 www.sec.gov 免費取得。我們在本檔中提及網站地址僅作為文字參考。本網站的資訊並未經引用納入本文件。
Primis 係著力於為其消費者及中小企業建立一個新穎、創新且更優質的銀行服務體驗。該銀行意圖透過著重以下三個領域來擴大其業務、擴大客戶羣並提升獲利能力：
1. 維持在優質市場中強而有力且運作高效的社區銀行。
a. 本銀行在維吉尼亞州、馬裏蘭州及華盛頓特區周邊市場維持二十四個營業據點
b. 在這些市場中，我們於 2025 年 12 月 31 日每分行存款（不含數位平台存款）增至 100 百萬美元，較 2021 年 12 月 31 日的 69 百萬美元為高
2. 以我們認為可產生高於平均風險調整後報酬的業務線來補強核心社區銀行成長與獲利能力，例如：
a. 本公司之 Panacea Financial Division，為銀行專注於健康照護領域之品牌，截至 2025 年底，貸款餘額為 544 百萬美元，存款餘額為 128 百萬美元。此數字較 2024 年 12 月 31 日之貸款餘額 434 百萬美元及存款餘額 92 百萬美元為高。
b. Primis Mortgage Company，為銀行的零售房貸公司，於2025年已資助約1.2 十億美元的房貸業務，較2024年的約800 百萬美元有所成長；以及
c. Mortgage Warehouse Lending，專注於向獨立房貸公司提供貸款，截至2025年底，已批准的貸款額度約為1.2 十億美元，未償還貸款餘額為318 百萬美元，且有29 百萬美元的低利率或無利率客戶存款。
3. 完善升級的數位服務，使Primis能夠在本行營運範圍內及範圍外的大規模吸引並留住存款客戶。
a. 截至2025年底，銀行數位平台的存款金額為992 百萬美元，平均餘額為48 千美元。截至2025年12月31日，這些客戶中有82%已在該數位平台服務超過2年。

paragraphs: 我們以一種我們認為將能帶動優質營運成果的方式，來組織核心銀行與各業務線。我們的策略重點在於於2025年1月出售生命優質信貸部門後，將獲利資產恢復至先前水準，增加非利息存款，並在零售房貸業務中實現更高的產出與獲利能力。我們在2025年持續成功執行我們的策略，包含以下關鍵亮點：
● 核心銀行的貸款組合在2025年12月31日幾乎維持不變，為21億美元，與2024年12月31日的22億美元相比。核心銀行的投資者商業不動產貸款佔整體貸款組合的比重相當低。
● 核心銀行的存款成本在2025年12月31日財年為1.74%，與2024年12月31日財年的2.15%相比。2025年12月31日，核心銀行的存款基礎約有23%為非利息存款。
● 核心銀行在2025年12月31日沒有經紀存款，且FHLB借款的使用率相當低。
● 2025年12月31日財年，未償貸款餘額成長25%至5.44億美元，與2024年12月31日的4.34億美元相比。此成長幅度即使在2025年12月進行了5,400萬美元貸款銷售後仍持續。
● 2025年12月31日，未償貸款餘額為3.18億美元，較2024年12月31日的6,400萬美元成長398%。
● 房貸倉庫資金約佔未償貸款的14%，與之相關的客戶非利息存款餘額在2025年12月31日為2,900萬美元。
● 承諾設施增至 252% 至 1.2 十億美元，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 349 百萬美元
● 本年截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的貸款餘額為 1.2 十億美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年貸款餘額增加 50%

投資本公司普通股涉及風險。以下為 Primis Financial Corp. 認為影響其業務之重大風險與不確定性之描述，投資人於投資本公司普通股前應加以考量。尚有我們未察覺或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，亦可能成為影響我們與我們業務之重要因素。若任何於本年度報告表 10-K 所述之風險實際發生，將可能對本公司財務狀況、營運結果與現金流造成重大且不利之影響。若發生此種情況，本公司普通股之價值可能顯著下跌，投資人可能損失全部或部分投資。本年度報告表 10-K 亦包含前瞻性陳述，這些陳述可能因某些因素而無法實現，包括但不限於 herein 所述之風險及本公司其他向 SEC 提交之公開檔中所提及之風險。請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 所稱之 "前瞻性陳述特別警示說明" 章節，以取得關於前瞻性陳述之更多資訊。
本公司業務面臨多項風險，包括可能使本公司無法達成業務目標或對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流與前景造成不利影響之風險。這些風險於摘要後有更詳細說明，風險包括但不限於以下內容：
● 本公司面臨因商業不動產與建築與土地開發貸款集中而產生之風險。
● 本公司有相當數額之無擔保消費者貸款，若借款人違約貸款，本公司無擔保品可追償潛在損失。
● 本公司消費者貸款組閤中有一部分由第三方發放與服務，並包含信用增強措施，該信用增強措施可能無法實現；無法利用此信用增強措施可能對本公司財務狀況與營運結果造成不利影響。
● 本公司第三方服務之消費者貸款中，有相當數額是在零利率促銷期間發放，使本公司面臨第三方信用風險，因借款人提前償還貸款而喪失利息收入；若該第三方無法履行其補償義務，可能對本公司財務狀況與營運結果造成不利影響。
